summary.intent: Get caliper to a v1 alpha by planning and executing a set of work trails: the user supplied a saved plan, then told the assistant to keep going until it was completely implemented and researched.
summary.outcome: Six intent-only Entire trails (#153-#158) were created with acceptance criteria and branch tables. Wave 1 was then started as three parallel isolated-worktree workers (two for trail 153, one for trail 154), still running at the end of the session with only oracle-compare files modified so far.

repo: Nothing in the caliper repo defines 'v1 alpha'; the user's plan file at ~/.claude/projects/-Users-gabe-Projects-caliper/plan/next-trails-2026-11-02.md is the source of truth and lives outside the repo so any session can read it.
Packages and crates are at 0.8.0 (semantic 0.2.0, tsc-client 0.1.1). The TypeScript 7.1 backend is experimental and off by default.
Recall against react-docgen-typescript ranges 40-99.7% by library, with shadcn/ui lowest at 39.5%.
Known gaps in docs/edge-cases.md: wrapper-call detection, component naming mismatches with RDT, ambient globals looked up from the first source directory only, and lossy TOON output.

Plan constraints: at most three live worker sessions, trail 156 must be stacked on trail 155's tip, and trail 158 depends on unanswered release-flow decisions (product package cargo/caliper-docgen, attached CLI binaries, build attestations).
A memory note, plan-trails-before-branches.md, requires trails to be created before branches.
workflow: Entire trails can be created intent-only with a body file, and the body can be verified afterwards with `entire trail show`.
Workers run in isolated worktrees and commit locally without pushing; the coordinator pushes, links and opens PRs after reviewing their reports.
The sandbox denies writes to the job tmp dir and to ~/.local/share/entire/, so scratch files go in $TMPDIR instead.
A later user instruction (keep going until fully implemented) overrode the earlier 'Wave 0 only, then wait' instruction from the pasted coordinator prompt.

friction: `entire brain brief` failed twice because the sandbox denied its write lock under ~/.local/share/entire/, and it was not retried outside the sandbox.
The job tmp dir was write-denied, so the trail body files had to be written to $TMPDIR instead.
The first orientation found no definition of 'v1 alpha', so the assistant had to ask the user to choose A, B or C before planning.
The pasted coordinator prompt said to wait, which conflicted with the user's later 'keep going' instruction.
open_items: Wait for the three Wave 1 workers (t153-weekly, t153-oracle, t154-perf) to finish, review their reports, then push, link and open PRs.
Run oracle/three-tools-report (trail 153) after the oracle stack lands.
Run trails 155 and 156 as one stack, then trail 157's independent branches.
Get the user's answers on trail 158's release-flow choices (product package, attached binaries, attestations) before that worker starts; the assistant asked whether to ask now or later.
Retry `entire brain brief` outside the sandbox.
Open issues remain: #279 (weekly measurement run recorded a worsening) and #1 (preset system with named PipelineOptions bundles).
Most Entire features come from help text only and are untried.
The raw research reports behind the plan exist only in a temporary workflow output; only key facts were copied into the plan file.
